nutrition: Predator with club-shaped raptorial appendages used to break hard prey.
habitat: Burrows in coral rubble and sediment on tropical Indo-Pacific reefs.
summary: Stalked compound eyes and a pair of folded striking clubs distinguish this reef smasher from the two spearers in the archive. Explore a trained polarization choice, an underwater photograph and the mitochondrial sequence of a museum voucher.

visual.description: Reference-guided adult exterior with authored shell, eye and club surfaces. Colours illustrate one appearance under visible light.
